sections.title: Data collected
sections.text: The contact form collects your name, email address and message. The quote form collects your name, email address, optionally your company, project type, budget range, desired timeframe, project description and consent. Requests are also rate-limited by IP address to help prevent abuse.

sections.title: Purposes and recipients
sections.text: Form data is used to review and respond to your message or quote request. It is sent by email to the recipient configured for the website through the Resend sending service. The website code does not store submissions in an application database. Any technical hosting logs and Resend’s processing terms should be confirmed against their respective settings and terms.
